items.message: Trag bei Anna Meier am 5. August 2026 nochmals Ferien ein, obwohl sie an dem Tag schon Ferien eingetragen hat.
items.comment: Duplicate-absence write. In production the add-absence-for-employee engine recipe forces this flow, so the replay excludes the item via EngineRecipeWouldTrigger (same pattern as ts-014). The BulkAddBreaks duplicate-absence guard refuses at execution time, which the turn-eval harness never runs and therefore cannot observe; the item only keeps measuring the recipe-forcing flag, not the refusal itself.

items.message: Plane Anna Meier am 3. August 2026 auf die Frühschicht ein, auch wenn der Tag gesperrt ist.
items.comment: Work placement on a day-locked date. Measures only that the model selects place_work as the write tool; client and shift ids are not resolvable in a single headless turn, so slots stay empty. The day-lock refusal is an execution-time guard the turn-eval harness does not run and cannot observe.

items.message: Anna Meier ist heute krank geworden. Organisier bitte eine Vertretung für ihre Schichten.
items.comment: Reactive cover-absence composite flow. Measures only that the model selects cover_absence as the entry tool; the harness does not execute the downstream scenario (record absence, propose rule-compliant replacement, approval), so slots stay empty and only tool selection is scored.

items.message: Anna Meier called in sick today — please organise a replacement to cover her shifts.
items.comment: English variant of the reactive cover-absence composite flow. Tool-selection only, same measurement boundary as ts-063.

items.message: Erstelle einen neuen Kunden Bäckerei Keller in Bern, lege dafür einen Mitarbeiter Hans Ott an, weise ihn der Gruppe Nord zu und plane für nächste Woche drei Frühdienste ein.
items.comment: Complex multi-mutation order (customer + employee + group assignment + shifts) with no guided recipe. PlanTriggerHeuristic flags several mutation segments, so the assembler surfaces create_plan and the model should propose a plan instead of running the actions one by one. Measures tool selection only; the 'goal' is free text so slots stay empty.

items.message: Create a new customer Baker Keller in Bern, add an employee Hans Ott, assign him to the North group and schedule three morning shifts for next week.
items.comment: English variant of the complex multi-mutation order. Same measurement boundary as ts-065: multiple mutation segments, no recipe, so create_plan is the expected proposal tool.

items.message: Wie weit ist mein Plan schon?
items.comment: Status question about the user's running multi-step plan. Read-only tool selection; no planId is given so the most recent plan is reported.

items.message: Is my plan done yet?
items.comment: English variant of the plan-status question. Same measurement boundary as ts-067.

items.message: Analysiere den Dienstplan von Juli und sag mir wo Lücken sind.
items.comment: Open-ended, multi-lookup analysis request (analyze a period, surface gaps). Belongs to the read-only research sub-loop tool run_analysis rather than a single concrete read tool.

items.message: Analyze the July roster and tell me where the gaps are.
items.comment: English variant of the analysis request. Same measurement boundary as ts-069: open-ended analysis over many read-only lookups maps to run_analysis.
